newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures rally again late, end up.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures rally again late, end up.

text.p: Oct 1 - U.S. stock index futures rallied again late to sharp gains and ended near session peaks. Traders said the ability of the Dow 30 to clear and end above 5900 for the first time persuaded more shorts to cover. Some said they looked for Dec S&P 500 to challenge the record high at 697.50, possibly Weds. Earlier, buy stops, signs of arb buy programs fueled gains. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
